note: Object-level security (OLS) and the Warehouse/SQL analytics endpoint T-SQL security (CREATE SECURITY POLICY, GRANT) are genuinely config/code rather than portal UI: OLS has no native authoring screen in the Fabric portal or Power BI Desktop (it's set via Tabular Editor or the XMLA endpoint/TOM), and the search for a dedicated 'service-admin-object-level-security' Microsoft Learn page returned 404 — that page no longer exists as a standalone doc. Those two topics are covered with 'steps' and 'code' slides instead of screenshots, consistent with SCREENSHOTS.md's documented fallback for genuinely non-visual config. All T-SQL code (CREATE FUNCTION/CREATE SECURITY POLICY/GRANT) was copied verbatim from Microsoft's own live Fabric Warehouse RLS/CLS documentation pages, confirmed 200 OK on 2026-10-05. The four RLS screenshots (above the 3-screenshot floor) came from one single official doc page, which was screenshot-dense enough to cover the full workflow: entry point, member assignment, Test as role, and View as.
